answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be continually earned through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities have almost no trusted incoming mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted paths cannot quickly amplify them. Like a velvet plume at a jetty, apparent presence is not proof of support: without credible links, a sybil cannot pass consensus thresholds.
